title: The True Bow Hero and His Companions
paragraphs: And so, it’s the next day.
“Yuki-chan. Today we’re swapping partners with the Rens.”
“Those black-clad folks, right? There was a Filolial-sama named Black Thunder… I’m curious to see what would happen if we had a race.”

Yuki-chan is a racer in this loop, isn’t she? Whenever she sees a Filolial-sama, she just can’t help but want to race them. By the way, as for Fleon-chan, she doesn’t seem to have that kind of interest. It seems the reason is that she flies rather than runs.
“Hey, hey, Kou wants to go play at Raph’s place.”
Kou has grown up and taken on the form of an angel. She’s already taken a liking to Big Sister and is saying she wants to go play. However, our purpose this time is the partner swap.
“I’d like you to be patient for a bit and go hunting with Yuki-chan and Ren. After that, you’re free to do as you please.”
“Got it!”
“I’ll do as Lord Motoyasu commands.”
Then, I’ll speak to the immortal who’s been taking care of Filolial-sama’s chicks, including Yuki-chan and the others. The Filolials are chirping happily, “Piyo piyo.”
“Spear Hero, I’ve hatched quite a few—is this enough?”
“That’s fine. Once we’ve wrapped up this round of companion exchanges, we’ll raise all of Filolial-sama’s chicks at once.”
“Ho ho ho… I’d love to laugh, but there are so many that I’m a bit worried. I’m not confident I can take proper care of them all.”
“Trust Yuki-chan and the others. If you do, Filolial-sama’s chicks will grow up freely and happily, just as you wish.”

It might be wise to raise Luna-chan as well, just to be safe? I’m sure we’ll run into her as soon as my Father starts clearing the land. It’d be nice to raise her alongside the others, but there’s no harm in raising her first.
“The Spear Hero’s hand at raising them is well-practiced—I’ve already seen how he handles Fleon and Black Thunder… as well as Yuki and Kou—so there’s surely no mistake.”
And so, leaving the care of the Filolial-sama to the Hermit, I set off.
So, leaving Yuki-chan and the others in charge, I made my way to the room where Ren’s companions were. I knocked and entered the room where Ren’s companions and Black Thunder were waiting.
“Welcome, The Love Hunter <TIME Drive>. You’ve come to guide those lacking in darkness in place of my partner, the Dark Swordsman <SHADOW Saint>, haven’t you?”
Black Thunder greeted me. On the other hand, Ren’s companions were looking at me with puzzled expressions.
“Spear Hero… it’s a pleasure to meet you. By the way, if I may ask a personal question—I happened to overhear that it was you, Spear Hero, who introduced this Black Thunder to Ren-sama.”
“That’s right.”
“How dare you…”
It felt like Ren’s companions were giving me a harsher look, but whatever.
“Well then, let’s head out hunting right away. Black Thunder, you know the drill, right?”
“Mm… You’ll be showing us a different tale—the *Chronicle* of the Spear Hero’s Dark Saint Hero <DARK Brave> adventure!　Come on, let these jet-black claws and fangs see for themselves!”

Black Thunder’s energy is as high as ever. So, with that, we set out on a hunt. That said, just like when I took Big Sister hunting, our goal remains the same: to defeat monsters and level up Ren’s party.
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Fire Eye X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Prominence X! Hahaha! Weak! Way too weak!”
“W-waaaaaaaaah!?”
“T-the island’s going to be burned to the ground!?”
“Black Thunder was one thing, and even that battle against the Filolial named Fleon was monstrous, but this is on a whole different level!”
“Lord Ren and the Bow Hero have both lost their minds! S-Shield Hero—! Stop him—!”
And so, for some reason, Ren’s companions are crying out for help.
“To be so terrified by a battle of this magnitude… it seems you still have a long way to go.”
Black Thunder was looking at Ren’s companions with a cold, detached gaze.

“Listen up. You must join the battle right here and say it… ‘Be destroyed by the flames of darkness…’ Unless you understand that, you won’t even be able to have your names recorded in the ‘Chronicle of the Dark Brave.’”
“We have absolutely no idea what you’re talking about!”
“Please bring Ren-sama back to normal! We cherished that clumsy but hardworking Ren-sama!”
“Um… how sinful is it to have turned Ren-sama—who was actually responsible and tried to keep us from doing reckless things—into that state! We’ll never forgive you!”
It seems Ren’s companions are voicing their discontent. But since following Ren—trusting him—leads to certain death, isn’t the current situation actually for the best?

“Not that topic again… The Shadow Saint has reached this point by liberating his own darkness and heart. The Sword Hero you all admire is nothing more than the oppressive shell the Shadow Saint was forcing himself to wear… If you truly care about the Shadow S'yne, you’d be better off returning that half-hearted kindness to the light at once.”

Black Thunder is admonishing Ren’s companions in a cold tone. He certainly has a point there. To be honest, when Ren set out for the First World and Faubrey with us, I had a feeling he was taking on more than he could handle. Ren seems very lively and happy in this loop. I’ll definitely introduce Black Thunder to Ren in future loops. Oh? It seems like the Ren who headed to the First World and Faubrey is shaking his head, but he’s probably just being modest. After all, the Ren from the loop where his Big Sister came to pick him up was having a great time playing with Kuro-chan, Black Thunder’s other form.
“I, too, am steeled my resolve and exercising restraint so that Ren can be his true self!”
“Spear Hero… you’re something else!”
Oh? Ren’s companions were glaring at me as if I were their sworn enemy, but there’s really no need to worry about that.
“I’ll definitely bring Lord Ren back to normal… Everyone, this is the time to hold on.”
“Ooh!”

And so, it seemed like Ren’s teammates were becoming much more united. Oh, and of course, in important battles—like the one against the island’s lord—we fought using all the practical skills we’d gained from our past experiences. After all, it would be pointless for me to just charge ahead and wreak havoc on my own. I’d imitate Father’s moves and fight in coordination with the others. Well, to be honest, Ren’s teammates were still so weak that it was more like I was helping them out. Since my Father had already taught them the importance of taking hits rather than dodging, it was tough to teach them other strategies.

By the way, Black Thunder was teaching them how to maintain the pose after landing a finishing move in a practical way while continuing the fight. So, the partner swap with Ren went off without a hitch.
When I returned to the hotel… Hmm? My Father and the others, along with Ren, were waiting in the lobby.
“Ah, the Spear Guy—how lovely!”
Eek! There’s Filo-tan right away!
“It’s a pleasure to see you.”
“Yeah!”
Filo-tan is staring at me with a face full of excitement. I’d better give her a souvenir and let her pass. Without delay, I used my spear to shape some kamaboko and handed it to Filo-tan.
“What’s this?”
“It’s kamaboko.”
“Oh, I remember this was in the dish you served before, Father—thank you!”

Saying that, Filo-tan took the kamaboko and started eating it. Then I headed over to Father, who was chatting with the Big Sisters in the hotel lobby. Black Thunder exchanged glances with Ren, then approached silently and stood beside him.
“…Motoyasu, is it?”
“The Shield Hero!”
Before I could even speak to my Father, Ren’s companions rushed over and clung to him.
“This man burned our island to the ground!”
“Yes… I understand how you feel. It’s amazing how, even after suffering such a devastating blow, monsters still swarm all over Cal Mira Island as if nothing happened just a few days later.”
Big Sister seemed to agree with Father and Ren’s companions, adopting a somewhat sympathetic tone.

“Ah… I’ve heard something about that. Apparently, pillars of fire were rising from the center of the island, and ordinary adventurers sensed danger and evacuated… Motoyasu’s the culprit, isn’t he? Maybe we should have an alert issued for any island Motoyasu visits.”
Father said this with a sigh. Is there some kind of problem?
“Since hardly anyone goes deep into the island’s interior, you can fight to your heart’s content, right?”

Well, I suppose that just goes to show how limited the strength of ordinary adventurers who venture into these active zones really is. Our previous runs have made that clear. Incidentally, according to Father’s analysis from the first world, it’s probably because defeating the island’s boss without a Hero isn’t worth it in terms of level gain. For adventurers who don’t get loot, it certainly wouldn’t be worth it. That said, there’s no doubt that my Big Sister’s Big Sisters or someone of the Panda Class could take down this boss without much trouble. My Big Sister’s Big Sisters are among the most skilled fighters in this world, after all. The same goes for that old woman who practices the Hengen Muso Style.
“That might be true, but better safe than sorry. Anyway, I guess we’ve pretty much completed one full run with this.”
“You swapped parties with Itsuki, didn’t you, Father? Did anything happen?”
The party swap between me and Ren went off without a hitch! The problem is Big Sister. I remember hearing that in the first world, Itsuki went easy on her, which caused her to get angry.

“No? Well, I talked to the brainwashed Filolial too, and I didn’t notice any particularly problematic behavior… aside from her energy being so over-the-top it’s exhausting. I also made it clear that if she tries to dump this trouble on me again, I won’t go easy on her. It doesn’t seem to be having much effect, so I’m not sure what to do.”
It looks like my father is repeatedly checking with my sister and her older sister to make sure he hasn’t been brainwashed himself.
“Still, even when I ride one of those ‘flying Filolials,’ I can’t really get the most out of it.”
My father seems to be making a self-deprecating remark, saying that there’s not much he can do if he’s just sitting there taking hits.
“Naofumi-chan is literally a shield. It’s a huge help to have him around when we’re under attack.”

It’s true that the combat style when Big Sister and Father team up is quite similar. In underwater combat, Big Sister possesses mobility rivaling Fleon-chan’s—she can easily slaughter even monsters of a higher rank, using Father as a shield to dodge the enemy’s attacks and deliver a fatal blow.
“Ah, yeah, yeah.”
“Since I also fight with a sword, coordinating with Fleon might be difficult.”

“We could probably manage with a hit-and-run tactic, but we wouldn’t be able to fully capitalize on our aerial advantage… Then there’s Rishia, who’s forced to wear that costume. She’s had a rough time, too.”
“Leiska, right?”
“So she’s been given a nickname that sounds like a monster…? I guess that’s better than me.”
“Better than what, exactly?”
I don’t really understand what my Father is talking about. So, this time, I’ll just focus on Big Sister. Then, Big Sister replies with a look of exasperation.
“There weren’t any major problems, but… I think I’m not much different from the Sword Hero.”
Oh, so Itsuki didn’t do anything to make Big Sister angry, either.
“Is this also the fault of Filolial’s brainwashing…? What would have happened normally, Motoyasu?”
“Big Sister would have been absolutely furious.”
“Well, I suppose I have no choice but to be glad about that.”
“With that? Well… ‘exhausted’ would be a more accurate description than ‘angry.’”
Judging by Yuki-chan’s reaction, it seems Itsuki has stopped holding back just to be polite. There’s no doubt about it.
“The archer said that Filo should do a ‘Marble Blast’ with Mel-chan.”
“So you know about that route too… Well, with Filo and Melty, maybe we could go with the ‘Those two!’ route… though I don’t know if Melty would actually do it.”

My father is showing his understanding of the tokusatsu shows that Itsuki knows. Ah! Come to think of it, my kind Father once said something similar to Sakura-chan and her Finacée when they were becoming idols—that they should sing and dance like that! It certainly suited them very well. I see—Itsuki must have a deep understanding of idols as well. It’d be a good idea to invite Filo-tan to join us when she becomes an idol someday!
“Itsuki-chan, you called your Big Sister a ‘good-guy monster’—what does that mean, I wonder?”
“Well… in Itsuki’s world, Sadeena would definitely fall into the ‘monster’ category. As for Raphtalia… I didn’t know how to classify her, so I just treated her casually.”
My Father muttered that it was nice, while my Big Sister said she wasn’t happy about it. Anyway, it seems the character swap went off without a hitch.
